points.description: Gives the correct final answer f(50) = 3, reached through valid steps only (e.g. f(50)=f(25)=f(24)+1=f(12)+1=f(6)+1=f(3)+1=f(2)+2=f(1)+2=3). Any valid alternative method earns the mark, such as noting f(n) is the number of 1s in the binary form of n (50 = 110010₂, three 1s). A wrong final answer, or any invalid or incorrect step, earns 0.

rubric.notes: Full mark only if every step is valid and the final answer is 3. A wrong step or wrong final answer earns 0. There are no part marks.
rubric.answer_key: f(50)=f(25) (50 even). f(25)=f(24)+1 (25 odd). f(24)=f(12)=f(6)=f(3) (even). f(3)=f(2)+1 and f(2)=f(1)=1, so f(3)=2. Then f(24)=2, f(25)=3, f(50)=3. Check: f(n) is the number of 1s in the binary form of n, and 50=110010₂ has three 1s. Final answer: 3.
